newsitem.title: UK: UKOOA names BHP exceutive as Aberdeen director.
newsitem.headline: UKOOA names BHP exceutive as Aberdeen director.

text.p: The U.K. Offshore Operators Association (UKOOA) on Monday appointed Australia's Broken Hill Proprietary Co Ltd executive John Wils as the director of the oil employers' body's Aberdeen office. Wils replaces John Mckinnell, a 30-year executive with the Royal Dutch/Shell Group, who retired after four years at UKOOA. A UKOOA statement said Wils, a chartered engineer, was chairman of UKOOA's operations committee in 1994 and was chairman of the Offshore Europe Conference in 1995.
His last position at BHP Petroleum was as asset manager for the Liverpool Bay development.
UKOOA represents 33 operating companies licensed to explore for and produce oil and gas in British waters.
